response.description:
Announcing new enhancements to GitHub Copilot App
Modernization that are in Public Preview, making it easier than ever to modernize applications,
databases, containers, and accelerate migration to Azure. Below are the new
capabilities in public preview.  For .NET applications:  
 New
     App Service Managed Instance as a target for easier migration of legacy
     Windows .NET apps (Public Preview) For Python applications: For Python,
customers can now migrate from semantic kernel to agent framework in Visual Studio
Code  Database Modernization:  
 Modernize
     PostgreSQL and SQL databases on Azure using the latest
     PostgreSQL extension (Public
     Preview) and the SQL Server modernization remains supported through
     the existing Azure Database Migration Service for SQL migration Portfolio Assessment Integration:
 Integrated
     portfolio assessment via GitHub Issues with Dr. Migrate and Azure Migrate,
     and CAST support coming soon. These capabilities help streamline modernization projects, reduce manual
effort, and accelerate your journey to Azure.Learn more:Read the blog.Start using GitHub Copilot app modernization. Refer
to the GitHub Copilot app modernization Generally Available capabilities at
Ignite.
response.title: Public Preview: GitHub Copilot app modernization expanded capabilities
